content: This is a detailed form used for the transfer, referral, or counter-referral of patients receiving generic HIV care or antiretroviral therapy (ART). Below is the breakdown of the form's components: Date: The date on which the referral or transfer is being made. Referring Facility: The name of the healthcare facility initiating the referral or transfer. Phone Number: The contact number of the referring facility for communication purposes. District: The geographical district where the referring facility is located. Referral To: The name of the facility or healthcare provider to which the patient is being referred. Reason: The specific reason for the referral or transfer of care. Unique ID: A unique identifier assigned to the patient for tracking and record-keeping. First Name: The patient’s given name. Last Name: The patient’s family name or surname. Date of Birth: The patient’s date of birth. Address: The residential address of the patient. Date Confirmed HIV Positive: The date on which the patient was confirmed to be HIV-positive. ART Start Date: The date the patient began antiretroviral therapy. Original First-Line Regimen: The initial ART regimen prescribed to the patient. First Substitution: Details of the first substitution in the ART regimen, including: Date: The date the substitution was made. Why: The reason for the substitution. Second Substitution: Details of the second substitution in the ART regimen, including: Date: The date the substitution was made. Why: The reason for the substitution. Second-Line Regimen: Information about the second-line ART regimen, including: Date: The date the second-line regimen was initiated. First Substitution: Details of the first substitution in the second-line regimen, including: Date: The date the substitution was made. Why: The reason for the substitution. Second Substitution: Details of the second substitution in the second-line regimen, including: Date: The date the substitution was made. Why: The reason for the substitution. Third-Line Regimen: Information about the third-line ART regimen, including: Date: The date the third-line regimen was initiated. First Substitution: Details of the first substitution in the third-line regimen, including: Date: The date the substitution was made. Why: The reason for the substitution. Second Substitution: Details of the second substitution in the third-line regimen, including: Date: The date the substitution was made. Why: The reason for the substitution. Most Recent CD4 Count: The patient’s most recent CD4 count, including: Date: The date the CD4 count was measured. Most Recent Viral Load (VL): The patient’s most recent viral load measurement, including: Date: The date the viral load was measured. Pregnancy Status: A checkbox to indicate if the patient is pregnant, along with the estimated delivery date (EDD). Breastfeeding Status: A checkbox to indicate if the patient is currently breastfeeding. On TB Preventive Therapy: A checkbox to indicate if the patient is currently on tuberculosis preventive therapy.
